preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have gained ownership)
Attacker must hold some KARMA tokens to initiate transfers

exploit_hint: The vulnerability is in the _takeLiquidity function where burnAmount is subtracted from _tTotalSupply but not from _tTotal. As owner, set burn fees to a high percentage (e.g., 100), then perform a transfer to trigger the burn mechanism. This will reduce totalSupply() while keeping _tTotal unchanged, creating an imbalance where sum(balances) > totalSupply(). Then swap tokens for ETH at the inflated valuation before the discrepancy is corrected.
